entries.e89e6608f092cd08: This is the sole business of the company group, which develops, manufactures, sells and repairs CNC grinding machines, mainly for the mold-related and cutting tool-related industries. The company and its Taiwan-based consolidated subsidiary, Waida Seiki Co., Ltd., are responsible for manufacturing and selling machine tools, while WAIDA Europe GmbH in Germany, WAIDA AMERICA INC. in the United States, and Waida Jichuang (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. in China are responsible for promoting sales of machine tools and providing after-sales support. Its customers span a wide range of fields, including electronic components, home appliances, semiconductors, IT-related equipment, precision machinery, mold manufacturing and cutting tool manufacturing, automobile manufacturing and automotive parts manufacturing. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,659 million. Its main facilities are the head office and head office factory (Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture), the Gifu factory and Chubu sales office (Kakamigahara City, Gifu Prefecture), and the Hamamatsu office (Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture).
